dashboard_rules_in_force_hint: Sites and apps across enabled lists
dashboard_lists_description: Turn a list on or off without leaving this page.
dashboard_no_lists_description: A block list groups the sites and apps you want out of the way. Create one to start.
dashboard_locked_tooltip: Locked until the protection window expires
error_block_list_not_found: That block list no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
error_rule_not_found: That rule no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
error_allowance_not_found: That allowance no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
error_protected: A lock is running on this list, so it cannot be changed until the lock expires.
error_unsupported: That is not available on this platform.
focus_session_description: Turns a block list on while you work and off during breaks.
focus_no_lists: Create a block list first, a session needs something to block.
health_body: Focuser cannot write the system hosts file, and no browser extension is connected, so your rules are saved but nothing is being blocked. Install the browser extension, or restart Focuser as administrator.
grid_aria: Weekly schedule, one column per hour. Use the day and hour headings to fill a whole row or column.
grid_hint: Drag to paint · click a day or hour heading to fill the whole row or column
schedule_always_body_before: This list applies whenever it is enabled, at any hour of any day. Switch to
schedule_always_body_after: to limit it to certain hours, useful when you only want to be blocked during work, or only in the evenings.
table_caption: Sites and apps by blocked attempts, busiest first
schedule_description: When this block list is active.
statistics_description: What Focuser has been keeping you away from.
statistics_chart_empty_description: Sites and apps get their own charts here once something is blocked.
statistics_table_empty_description: Numbers appear here once a block list starts turning things away.
settings_description: How Focuser behaves on this machine.
settings_autostart_description: Focuser starts with your computer, so blocks are in place before you can talk yourself out of them.
settings_autostart_unsupported: Only available in the desktop app.
settings_browsers_description: The extension blocks pages properly. Without it, only whole domains can be stopped.
settings_close_browsers_description: Applies while a block list is active.
settings_grace_period_description: How long to wait before closing one, so there is time to install it.
settings_extension_description: Where the Focuser extension is installed.
settings_config_file_description: Export every block list to a file, or replace them from one. Statistics and settings are not included.
settings_reset_description: Puts everything on this page back to its default. Block lists and statistics are untouched.
settings_delete_all_description: Block lists, rules, schedules, statistics and settings. This cannot be undone.
settings_language_description: Every language but English is a first draft, written without a native speaker checking it. If something reads badly in yours, TRANSLATING.md explains how to fix it.
lists_description: Group the sites and apps you want blocked together. Each list can be scheduled and locked on its own.
lists_new_placeholder: Name a new block list — “Deep work”, “Evenings”…
lists_empty_description: Create one above, then add the sites and apps that pull you away.
lists_toggle_locked: A lock is running, so this cannot be turned off
lists_toggle_hint: Turn this list on or off
lists_protect_hint: Lock this list on for a set time
lists_lock_warning: There is no way to cancel it early. That is the point.
allowances_description: A daily budget instead of an outright block. When it runs out, the site or app is blocked for the rest of the day.
allowances_empty_description: An allowance is a daily budget rather than a wall, thirty minutes of something and then it closes for the day.
allowances_used_all: Used all {limit}, blocked for the rest of today
allowances_extension_needed_title: Website allowances need the browser extension
allowances_extension_needed_body: Only the extension can see which tab is open, so without it the timer never starts. Those sites stay blocked in the meantime, because an allowance that cannot be measured would otherwise be an unlimited pass. Install it from Settings.
allowances_wayland_title: Application allowances cannot be measured on Wayland
allowances_wayland_body: Wayland has no way for one program to ask which window is in front, so the timer never starts. Those apps stay blocked in the meantime. Logging in with an Xorg session makes it work. Website allowances are unaffected.
apps_description: Programs to close while blocking is active.
apps_empty_description: Add an executable name like {example}, or browse for one on disk.
websites_description: Domains, keywords and URL patterns to block.
websites_hint_keyword: Blocks any URL containing this word. Extension only.
websites_hint_wildcard: * matches any run of characters, and *.reddit.com covers reddit.com too. Extension only.
websites_hint_url_path: Blocks URLs containing this path. Extension only.
websites_hint_entire_internet: Blocks every site except your exceptions, so add those first. Extension only.
websites_hint_catch_all: This matches every site, including local pages and your own machine. Pick Entire internet instead if that is what you want, and add exceptions first.
websites_empty_description: Add a domain above, or import one of the curated starter lists.
websites_extension_needed_title: Keyword, wildcard and URL path rules need the browser extension
websites_extension_needed_body: Focuser blocks plain domains through the hosts file, but that file has no way to express a pattern. Those rules are being ignored right now. Install the extension from Settings and they start working straight away. Domain rules are unaffected.
websites_no_lists_description: Create one on the Block Lists page first.
exceptions_intro: Exceptions stay reachable even when a rule above would block them.
exceptions_empty_description: An exception stays reachable even when a rule above would block it.
import_intro: One value per line. Blank lines, duplicates and # comments are skipped.
